OA-exp1

Seongyun Kim

2026-11-09

In Experiment 1, YAs and OAs completed the Grid Learning Task (Chaloupka & Zeithamova, 2024), the Mnemonic Similarity Task (Kirwan & Stark, 2007; Stark et al., 2019), and Neuropyschological assessments.
In the data file, YAs’ SID starts with 3XX (age group = 0), OAs’ SID starts with 2XX (age group = 1). The first OA’s SID is 227, because prior to 227 was pilot (as described in the footnote of the manuscript).

1 Organizing data

1.1 Methods participants; neuropsychological tests, tech issue based exclusion

Based on MoCA cutoff of 23 (Carson et al., 2018; Stanford et al., 2022), 10 OAs and 5 YAs were excluded. 7 OAs and 1 YAs were additionally excluded for not being able to complete the session due to technical issues, and for quitting the task in the middle due to perceived difficulty.

# npsych data
npsych <- read.csv("data/6x6-glt-age-npsych-complete.csv")

npsych <- npsych %>% mutate(adjusted_moca = ifelse(edu == "completed high school/GED" & SID < 300, moca+1, moca))

npsych <- npsych[, c(1:6, 17, 7:16)]

npsych_include <- npsych %>% filter(adjusted_moca >= 23) %>% 
  filter(!(note %in% c("tech-issue", "quit-in-the-middle")))

npsych %>% filter(SID < 300 & adjusted_moca < 23) #OA: 10 were excluded

Organized GLT files (YAs)

# glt
glt_dir <- "data/glt"

fileLst <- list.files(glt_dir, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

# YA
number <- as.numeric(substr(basename(fileLst), 1, 3))
newYA <- fileLst[!is.na(number) & number > 300 & number < 400]

tg <- do.call(bind_rows, lapply(newYA, function(file) {
  tg.df <- read.csv(file)
  tg.df$welcome_resp.duration <- as.numeric(tg.df$welcome_resp.duration)
  tg.df$space_end_trial_t_3.duration <- as.numeric(tg.df$space_end_trial_t_3.duration)
  tg.df$space_end_trial_1.duration <- as.numeric(tg.df$space_end_trial_1.duration)
  tg.df$maths_resp.duration <- as.numeric(tg.df$maths_resp.duration)
  tg.df$frameRate <- as.numeric(tg.df$frameRate)# Force to numeric
  tg.df
})) %>% rename(SID = participant)

gltraw <- tg

No YA was excluded based on the math distractor task criteria (< 75% accuracy).

gltraw <- gltraw %>% dplyr::select('SID', 'condition', 'order', 
                            'score_1', 'score_2', 'score_3', 'score_4', 'maths_resp.corr')

# No YA was excluded based on the math distractor task criteria (< 75% accuracy).
gltraw %>% group_by(SID) %>% summarise(mean.acc = mean(maths_resp.corr, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  filter(mean.acc < 0.75) 
## # A tibble: 0 × 2
## # ℹ 2 variables: SID <int>, mean.acc <dbl>
df.ya <- gltraw %>% group_by(SID) %>% summarise(condition = condition[condition != ""],
                                              order = first(order[!is.na(score_1)]))

df.item <- df.ya[rep(seq_len(nrow(df.ya)), each = 6), ]

trial_tmp <- c(rep(c(1:6), nrow(df.ya)))

df.item <- df.item %>% mutate(trials = rep(trial_tmp, length.out = n()),
                              grid1 = NA,
                              grid2 = NA,
                              grid3 = NA,
                              grid4 = NA)

tmp_grid1 <- gltraw %>% group_by(SID) %>% reframe(grid1 = score_1[!is.na(score_1)]) 
tmp_grid1 <- tmp_grid1 %>% group_by(SID) %>% 
  mutate(trials = row_number()) %>% ungroup()

tmp1 <- merge(df.item[, c("SID", "trials", "order")], tmp_grid1, by = c("SID", "trials"), all.x = TRUE)

tmp_grid2 <- gltraw %>% group_by(SID) %>% reframe(grid2 = score_2[!is.na(score_2)]) 
tmp_grid2 <- tmp_grid2 %>% group_by(SID) %>% 
  mutate(trials = row_number()) %>% ungroup()
tmp2 <- merge(tmp1[, c("SID", "order", "trials","grid1")], tmp_grid2, by = c("SID", "trials"), all.x = TRUE)

tmp_grid3 <- gltraw %>% group_by(SID) %>% reframe(grid3 = score_3[!is.na(score_3)]) 
tmp_grid3 <- tmp_grid3 %>% group_by(SID) %>% 
  mutate(trials = row_number()) %>% ungroup()
tmp3<-merge(tmp2[, c("SID", "order","trials","grid1","grid2")], tmp_grid3, by = c("SID", "trials"), all.x = TRUE)

tmp_grid4 <- gltraw %>% group_by(SID) %>% reframe(grid4 = score_4[!is.na(score_4)]) 
tmp_grid4 <- tmp_grid4 %>% group_by(SID) %>% 
  mutate(trials = row_number()) %>% ungroup()
trial.df <- merge(tmp3[, c("SID", "order","trials","grid1","grid2","grid3")], tmp_grid4, by = c("SID", "trials"), all.x = TRUE)

nu.df1 <- trial.df %>% group_by(SID) %>% summarise(grid1 = sum(grid1),
                                                     grid2 = sum(grid2),
                                                     grid3 = sum(grid3),
                                                     grid4 = sum(grid4),
                                                     order = first(order))

nu.df1.delta <- nu.df1 %>% mutate(score1 = grid2 - grid1,
                                  score2 = grid3 - grid2,
                                  score3 = grid4 - grid3) %>% 
  mutate(none = case_when(order == 'none_obj_loc' | order == 'none_loc_obj' ~ score1,
                          order == 'obj_none_loc' | order == 'loc_none_obj' ~ score2,
                          order == 'obj_loc_none' | order == 'loc_obj_none' ~ score3),
         object = case_when(order == 'obj_loc_none' | order == 'obj_none_loc' ~ score1,
                            order == 'none_obj_loc' | order == 'loc_obj_none' ~ score2,
                            order == 'none_loc_obj' | order == 'loc_none_obj' ~ score3),
         location = case_when(order == 'loc_none_obj' | order == 'loc_obj_none' ~ score1,
                              order == 'none_loc_obj' | order == 'obj_loc_none' ~ score2,
                              order == 'none_obj_loc' | order == 'obj_none_loc' ~ score3))

Organized OA GLT files.
The conditions for SIDs 227, 228 and 231 were initially recorded incorrectly, but they were able to be corrected based on the conditions the participants actually experienced during the session (and thus, were excluded at the beginning of this script). This condition file mismatch issue was fixed after SID 233.
And again, no OAs were excluded based on the math distractor task criteria (< 75% accuracy).

#OA
fileLst <- list.files(glt_dir, pattern = "*.csv", full.names = TRUE)

number <- as.numeric(sapply(basename(fileLst), \(x) substr(x, 1, 3)))
sbs <- fileLst[number >= 227 & number < 300]

oa.tmps <- lapply(sbs, function(path) {
  oa.tmps <- read.csv(path)
  oa.tmps$frameRate <- as.character(oa.tmps$frameRate)
  return(oa.tmps)}) %>% 
  bind_rows() %>%
  rename(SID = participant)

oa.tmps <- oa.tmps %>% dplyr::select('SID', 'condition', 'order',
                'score_1', 'score_2', 'score_3', 'score_4',
                'maths_resp.corr')
oa.tmps <- oa.tmps %>% filter(!(SID %in% oa.tq$SID)) # excluded who experienced tech-issue/quit in the middle

oa.tmps %>% group_by(SID) %>% summarise(mean.acc = mean(maths_resp.corr, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  filter(mean.acc < 0.75)
## # A tibble: 0 × 2
## # ℹ 2 variables: SID <int>, mean.acc <dbl>
tmp_grid1 <- oa.tmps %>% group_by(SID, order) %>% reframe(grid1 = score_1[!is.na(score_1)]) 
tmp1 <- tmp_grid1 %>% group_by(SID) %>% 
  mutate(trials = row_number()) %>% ungroup()

tmp_grid2 <- oa.tmps %>% group_by(SID) %>% reframe(grid2 = score_2[!is.na(score_2)]) 
tmp_grid2 <- tmp_grid2 %>% group_by(SID) %>% 
  mutate(trials = row_number()) %>% ungroup()
tmp2 <- merge(tmp1[, c("SID", "order", "trials","grid1")], tmp_grid2, by = c("SID", "trials"), all.x = TRUE)

tmp_grid3 <- oa.tmps %>% group_by(SID) %>% reframe(grid3 = score_3[!is.na(score_3)]) 
tmp_grid3 <- tmp_grid3 %>% group_by(SID) %>% 
  mutate(trials = row_number()) %>% ungroup()
tmp3 <- merge(tmp2[, c("SID", "order","trials","grid1","grid2")], tmp_grid3, by = c("SID", "trials"), all.x = TRUE)

tmp_grid4 <- oa.tmps %>% group_by(SID) %>% reframe(grid4 = score_4[!is.na(score_4)]) 
tmp_grid4 <- tmp_grid4 %>% group_by(SID) %>% 
  mutate(trials = row_number()) %>% ungroup()
trial.df.oa <- merge(tmp3[, c("SID", "order","trials","grid1","grid2","grid3")], tmp_grid4, by = c("SID", "trials"), all.x = TRUE)

# revised Key:
# 1: none_obj_loc
# 2: none_loc_obj
# 3: obj_loc_none
# 4: obj_none_loc
# 5: loc_none_obj
# 6: loc_obj_none

# 6 x 6 = 36 max score for each grid
nu.oadf1 <- trial.df.oa %>% group_by(SID) %>% summarise(grid1 = sum(grid1),
                                                     grid2 = sum(grid2),
                                                     grid3 = sum(grid3),
                                                     grid4 = sum(grid4),
                                                     order = first(order))

# SID 228, 231 condition numbers were mismatched (see the note above).
nu.oadf1$order[nu.oadf1$SID == 228] <- 'none_obj_loc' 
nu.oadf1$order[nu.oadf1$SID == 231] <- 'obj_none_loc'

nu.oadf1.d <- nu.oadf1 %>% mutate(score1 = grid2 - grid1,
                                  score2 = grid3 - grid2,
                                  score3 = grid4 - grid3) %>% 
  mutate(none = case_when(order == 'none_obj_loc' | order == 'none_loc_obj' ~ score1,
                          order == 'obj_none_loc' | order == 'loc_none_obj' ~ score2,
                          order == 'obj_loc_none' | order == 'loc_obj_none' ~ score3),
         object = case_when(order == 'obj_loc_none' | order == 'obj_none_loc' ~ score1,
                            order == 'none_obj_loc' | order == 'loc_obj_none' ~ score2,
                            order == 'none_loc_obj' | order == 'loc_none_obj' ~ score3),
         location = case_when(order == 'loc_none_obj' | order == 'loc_obj_none' ~ score1,
                              order == 'none_loc_obj' | order == 'obj_loc_none' ~ score2,
                              order == 'none_obj_loc' | order == 'obj_none_loc' ~ score3)) 
## Organizing the MST data. 
mst_dir <- "data/mst"

# read each file 
filenames <- list.files(mst_dir)
mstraw <- do.call(rbind, lapply(paste(mst_dir, filenames, sep = "/"), fromJSON))

mstdf <- mstraw %>% dplyr::filter(summary != "NA") %>% dplyr::select(subject, summary) %>% 
  arrange(subject) %>% 
  rename(SID = subject)

# make summary column neater
tmp <- strsplit(mstdf$summary, split = '\n')

extract_values <- function(item) {
  valid <- as.numeric(unlist(strsplit(item[1], ", "))[2:4])
  old <- as.numeric(unlist(strsplit(item[2], ", "))[2:4])
  similar <- as.numeric(unlist(strsplit(item[3], ", "))[2:4])
  new <- as.numeric(unlist(strsplit(item[4], ", "))[2:4])
  rec <- as.numeric(unlist(strsplit(item[5], ", "))[2])
  ldi <- as.numeric(unlist(strsplit(item[5], ", "))[4])
  return(c(valid, old, similar, new, rec, ldi))
}

df_data <- do.call(rbind, lapply(tmp, extract_values))

df3 <- as.data.frame(df_data)
colnames(df3) <- c("Valid1", "Valid2", "Valid3", 
                   "Old1", "Old2", "Old3", 
                   "Similar1", "Similar2", "Similar3", 
                   "New1", "New2", "New3", 
                   "REC", "LDI")
mstdf <- cbind(mstdf, df3)

mstdf$SID <- as.numeric(mstdf$SID)
mstdf$REC <- as.numeric(mstdf$REC)
mstdf$LDI <- as.numeric(mstdf$LDI)

1.2 Methods participants; MST performanced based exclusion

3 YAs fell outside of 2SD of the REC. (SID 314, 329, 353). 2 OAs selected a particular response option in fewer than 10% of trials (SID 241,260). 2 OAs fell outside of 2SD of the REC. (SID 255, 264).

#ya mst
use.yamst <- mstdf %>% dplyr::filter(SID > 300) %>% dplyr::filter(SID < 800) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(SID %in% npsych_include$SID)

# No YA was excluded based on selecting a particular response option in fewer than 10% of trials
use.yamst %>% dplyr::filter(Old1+Old2+Old3 < 19.2|
                        Similar1+Similar2+Similar3 < 19.2 |
                        New1+New2+New3 < 19.2) 
##  [1] SID      summary  Valid1   Valid2   Valid3   Old1     Old2     Old3    
##  [9] Similar1 Similar2 Similar3 New1     New2     New3     REC      LDI     
## <0 rows> (or 0-length row.names)
use.yamst %>% dplyr::filter(Old1+Old2+Old3 > 172.8|
                       Similar1+Similar2+Similar3 > 172.8|
                       New1+New2+New3 > 172.8) 
##  [1] SID      summary  Valid1   Valid2   Valid3   Old1     Old2     Old3    
##  [9] Similar1 Similar2 Similar3 New1     New2     New3     REC      LDI     
## <0 rows> (or 0-length row.names)
use.yamst.sum <- use.yamst %>% summarise(rmean=mean(REC), rsd=sd(REC), 
                                         up_sd = rmean+2*rsd, down_sd = rmean-2*rsd,
          lmean=mean(LDI), lsd=sd(LDI), lup_sd = lmean+2*lsd,
          ldown_sd = lmean-2*lsd)

# 3 YAs fell outside of 2SD of the REC (Stark & Stark, 2017).

### Combined the GLT and MST data.  
ya.del <- nu.df1.delta %>%
  filter(SID %in% ya.final$SID) %>% mutate(age = 0)
oa.d <- nu.oadf1.d  %>% 
  filter(SID %in% oa.final$SID) %>% mutate(age = 1)

tg <- rbind(ya.del, oa.d)

glt.mst.tg <- merge(tg, mst.tg, by = "SID") 

glt.mst.tg$SID <- as.factor(glt.mst.tg$SID)
glt.mst.tg$age <- as.factor(glt.mst.tg$age)

2 Stats: Npsychs

2.1 Methods; Table 1: Neuropsychological assessments

2.2 Results: Neuropsychological Assessments.

# npsych comparison
np <- rbind(ya.npsych, oa.npsych)
np$age <- as.factor(np$age)

2.2.1 Normality Assumption

# Normality
vars <- c("adjusted_moca", "RAVLT_total", "RAVLT_A6_Recall",
          "RAVLT_A_Delayed_Recall", "Digit_Forward_Score", "Digit_Backwards_Score")

np_long <- np %>% dplyr::select(age, all_of(vars)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-age, names_to = "variable", values_to = "score")

ggplot(np_long, aes(sample = score)) + stat_qq() +
  stat_qq_line() + facet_grid(age ~ variable, scales = "free") +
  theme_bw()

2.2.2 MoCA Score

The homogeneity of variance assumption was met.

#moca
levene_test(adjusted_moca ~ age, data = np)
## # A tibble: 1 × 4
##     df1   df2 statistic     p
##   <int> <int>     <dbl> <dbl>
## 1     1    82     0.211 0.647
t.test(adjusted_moca ~ age, data = np, var.equal = TRUE)
## 
##  Two Sample t-test
## 
## data:  adjusted_moca by age
## t = 0.98494, df = 82, p-value = 0.3275
## alternative hypothesis: true difference in means between group OA and group YA is not equal to 0
## 95 percent confidence interval:
##  -0.4613066  1.3660685
## sample estimates:
## mean in group OA mean in group YA 
##         26.52381         26.07143
cohens_d(adjusted_moca ~ age, data = np)
## Cohen's d |        95% CI
## -------------------------
## 0.21      | [-0.21, 0.64]
## 
## - Estimated using pooled SD.

3 Results: Grid Learning Task performance.

3.1 descriptive stats

tg.r_long <- tg %>% pivot_longer(cols = c(grid1, grid2, grid3, grid4),
                                         names_to = "grid",
                                         values_to = "rawScore")

tg.r_long$SID <- as.factor(tg.r_long$SID)
tg.r_long$grid <- as.factor(tg.r_long$grid)
tg.r_long$age <- as.factor(tg.r_long$age)

# Across grid number (Grid 1, Grid 2, Grid 3, Grid 4)
tg.r_long %>% group_by(grid) %>% summarize(rm = round(mean(rawScore),2), 
                                           rs = round(sd(rawScore),2)) %>%
  mutate(across(c(rm, rs), ~ sprintf("%.3f", .x)))
## # A tibble: 4 × 3
##   grid  rm     rs   
##   <fct> <chr>  <chr>
## 1 grid1 20.960 8.320
## 2 grid2 24.260 8.300
## 3 grid3 24.770 8.530
## 4 grid4 25.640 8.440
# Age group (0, 1) x grid number (Grid 1, Grid 2, Grid 3, Grid 4)
tg.r_long  %>% group_by(age, grid) %>% summarize(rm = round(mean(rawScore),2), 
                                           rs = round(sd(rawScore),2)) %>%
  mutate(across(c(rm, rs), ~ sprintf("%.3f", .x)))
## # A tibble: 8 × 4
## # Groups:   age [2]
##   age   grid  rm     rs   
##   <fct> <fct> <chr>  <chr>
## 1 0     grid1 25.740 7.270
## 2 0     grid2 29.740 4.620
## 3 0     grid3 29.740 6.080
## 4 0     grid4 29.830 6.450
## 5 1     grid1 16.190 6.370
## 6 1     grid2 18.790 7.520
## 7 1     grid3 19.810 7.740
## 8 1     grid4 21.450 8.160
# Age (0, 1)
tg.r_long  %>% group_by(age) %>% summarize(rm = mean(rawScore), rs = sd(rawScore)) %>%
  mutate(across(c(rm, rs), ~ sprintf("%.3f", .x)))
## # A tibble: 2 × 3
##   age   rm     rs   
##   <fct> <chr>  <chr>
## 1 0     28.762 6.370
## 2 1     19.060 7.652
# assumption of homoscedasticity: violated 
tg.r_long %>% group_by(grid) %>% 
  levene_test(rawScore ~ age)
## # A tibble: 4 × 5
##   grid    df1   df2 statistic      p
##   <fct> <int> <int>     <dbl>  <dbl>
## 1 grid1     1    82     0.801 0.373 
## 2 grid2     1    82     6.55  0.0123
## 3 grid3     1    82     6.77  0.0110
## 4 grid4     1    82     2.67  0.106
#normality test 
par(mfrow = c(2, 4))

for (grp in c(0, 1)) {
  for (g in paste0("grid", 1:4)) {
    x <- tg$age == grp
    qqnorm(tg[[g]][x], main = paste(grp, g))
    qqline(tg[[g]][x])
  }
}

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

3.2 LMM

tg.r_long$rawScore_z <- as.numeric(scale(tg.r_long$rawScore))
r.aov <- lmerTest::lmer(rawScore_z ~ age * grid + (1|SID),
                        data = tg.r_long)
summary(r.aov)

# Sensitivity analysis with heterogeneous residual variance

m_hom <- lme(rawScore ~ age*grid, random = ~ 1 | SID,
             data = tg.r_long, method = "REML")
m_het <- update(m_hom, weights = varIdent(form = ~ 1 | age * grid))
m_het2 <- update(m_hom, weights = varIdent(form = ~ 1 | age))

anova(m_hom, m_het2, m_het)
##        Model df      AIC      BIC    logLik   Test  L.Ratio p-value
## m_hom      1 10 2182.861 2220.791 -1081.430                        
## m_het2     2 11 2179.273 2220.996 -1078.636 1 vs 2  5.58807  0.0181
## m_het      3 17 2179.924 2244.405 -1072.962 2 vs 3 11.34914  0.0782
anova(m_het2) #The fixed-effect results were unchanged under the age-specific variance model
##             numDF denDF   F-value p-value
## (Intercept)     1   246 1933.7907  <.0001
## age             1    82   77.5018  <.0001
## grid            3   246   12.7328  <.0001
## age:grid        3   246    0.8352  0.4757

4 Results: Effects of overlap type on new learning.

4.1 Descriptive Stats

glt.mst.tg <- glt.mst.tg %>% pivot_longer(cols = c('none','object','location'),
                                          names_to = 'whichCondition',
                                          values_to = 'Score') 
glt.mst.tg.long <- glt.mst.tg %>% dplyr::select(SID, whichCondition, Score, 
                                         age, order, REC, LDI)

glt.mst.tg.long$SID <- factor(glt.mst.tg.long$SID)
glt.mst.tg.long$age <- factor(glt.mst.tg.long$age)
glt.mst.tg.long$whichCondition <- factor(glt.mst.tg.long$whichCondition)
glt.mst.tg.long$order <- factor(glt.mst.tg.long$order)

glt.mst.tg.long %>% group_by(age, whichCondition) %>% 
  summarise(m = mean(Score), s = sd(Score))

## 6 1     object         -4.12   7.67

4.2 regression model

abbr <- c(none = "none", object = "obj", location = "loc")

glt.mst.tg.long <- glt.mst.tg.long %>% rowwise() %>%
  mutate(position = match(abbr[as.character(whichCondition)],
                          strsplit(as.character(order), "_")[[1]]))

glt.mst.tg.long$position <- as.factor(glt.mst.tg.long$position)
glt.mst.tg.long$whichCondition <- fct_relevel(glt.mst.tg.long$whichCondition, c("none","object","location"))
glt.mst.tg.long$Score_z <- as.numeric(scale(glt.mst.tg.long$Score))

# assumption of homoscedasticity
glt.mst.tg.long %>% group_by(whichCondition) %>%
  levene_test(Score ~ age)
## # A tibble: 3 × 5
##   whichCondition   df1   df2 statistic      p
##   <fct>          <int> <int>     <dbl>  <dbl>
## 1 none               1    82    0.0275 0.869 
## 2 object             1    82    1.62   0.206 
## 3 location           1    82    3.13   0.0805
#normality test 
for (grp in c(0, 1)) {
  par(mfrow = c(3, 6), mar = c(4, 4, 2, 1))
  for (a in levels(factor(glt.mst.tg.long$whichCondition))) {
    for (b in levels(factor(glt.mst.tg.long$position))) {
      x <- glt.mst.tg.long$age == grp & factor(glt.mst.tg.long$whichCondition) == a & factor(glt.mst.tg.long$position) == b
      vals <- glt.mst.tg.long$Score[x]
      if (sum(!is.na(vals)) < 3) next
      qqnorm(vals, main = paste(grp, a, b, sep = " | "), cex.main = 0.8)
      qqline(vals)
    }
  }
}

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

The linear regression model included age, overlap type (here written as whichCondition), position, and interactions between as fixed effects.

mod_pos <- lm(Score_z ~ age * whichCondition + position,
              data = glt.mst.tg.long)

mod_pos2 <- lm(Score_z ~ age * whichCondition * position,
              data = glt.mst.tg.long)

anova(mod_pos, mod_pos2) # mod_pos is the winning model
## Analysis of Variance Table
## 
## Model 1: Score_z ~ age * whichCondition + position
## Model 2: Score_z ~ age * whichCondition * position
##   Res.Df    RSS Df Sum of Sq      F Pr(>F)
## 1    244 173.22                           
## 2    234 167.56 10    5.6586 0.7902 0.6383
summary(mod_pos)
## 
## Call:
## lm(formula = Score_z ~ age * whichCondition + position, data = glt.mst.tg.long)
## 
## Residuals:
##     Min      1Q  Median      3Q     Max 
## -2.1166 -0.5156 -0.0049  0.5578  2.1115 
## 
## Coefficients:
##                              Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)    
## (Intercept)                 -0.008251   0.150140  -0.055 0.956222    
## age1                         0.155350   0.183942   0.845 0.399185    
## whichConditionobject        -0.033918   0.183864  -0.184 0.853797    
## whichConditionlocation       0.693770   0.183864   3.773 0.000202 ***
## position2                   -0.360761   0.130011  -2.775 0.005950 ** 
## position3                   -0.349884   0.130178  -2.688 0.007689 ** 
## age1:whichConditionobject   -0.611696   0.260078  -2.352 0.019470 *  
## age1:whichConditionlocation  0.296735   0.260244   1.140 0.255314    
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1

## F-statistic: 15.65 on 7 and 244 DF,  p-value: < 2.2e-16

4.3 planned simple-effect contrasts: age x overlap type, and position

emm_age <- emmeans(mod_pos, ~ whichCondition | age)
contrast(emm_age, method = "trt.vs.ctrl", ref = "none", adjust = "none")
## age = 0:
##  contrast        estimate    SE  df t.ratio p.value
##  object - none    -0.0339 0.184 244  -0.184  0.8538
##  location - none   0.6938 0.184 244   3.773  0.0002
## 
## age = 1:
##  contrast        estimate    SE  df t.ratio p.value
##  object - none    -0.6456 0.184 244  -3.510  0.0005
##  location - none   0.9905 0.184 244   5.378  <.0001
## 
## Results are averaged over the levels of: position
emm_cond <- emmeans(mod_pos, ~ whichCondition * age)
contrast(emm_cond, interaction = c("trt.vs.ctrl", "pairwise"), ref = "none", adjust = "none")
##  whichCondition_trt.vs.ctrl age_pairwise estimate   SE  df t.ratio p.value
##  object - none              0 - 1           0.612 0.26 244   2.352  0.0195
##  location - none            0 - 1          -0.297 0.26 244  -1.140  0.2553
## 
## Results are averaged over the levels of: position
emmeans(mod_pos, pairwise ~ position, adjust = "BH")
## $emmeans
##  position emmean    SE  df lower.CL upper.CL
##  1         0.237 0.092 244   0.0557   0.4180
##  2        -0.124 0.092 244  -0.3050   0.0573
##  3        -0.113 0.092 244  -0.2943   0.0683
## 
## Results are averaged over the levels of: age, whichCondition 
## Confidence level used: 0.95 
## 
## $contrasts
##  contrast              estimate   SE  df t.ratio p.value
##  position1 - position2   0.3608 0.13 244   2.775  0.0115
##  position1 - position3   0.3499 0.13 244   2.688  0.0115
##  position2 - position3  -0.0109 0.13 244  -0.084  0.9335
## 
## Results are averaged over the levels of: age, whichCondition 
## P value adjustment: BH method for 3 tests
contrast(emm_cond, interaction = c("trt.vs.ctrl", "pairwise"), ref = "none", adjust = "none")
##  whichCondition_trt.vs.ctrl age_pairwise estimate   SE  df t.ratio p.value
##  object - none              0 - 1           0.612 0.26 244   2.352  0.0195
##  location - none            0 - 1          -0.297 0.26 244  -1.140  0.2553
## 
## Results are averaged over the levels of: position
# graph
glt.mst.tg.long$whichCondition <- fct_relevel(glt.mst.tg.long$whichCondition,c("object","none","location"))
  
glt.mst.tg.long %>% ggplot(aes(x = whichCondition, y = Score,
             fill = whichCondition, group = age, shape = age)) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = whichCondition),
              position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.2, dodge.width = 0.6),
              size = 2.5, alpha = .6) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_cl_normal, geom = "errorbar",
               width = 0.15, position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point",
               size = 3.5, position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#033DA5", "#747474", "#FFC951")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#033DA5", "#747474", "#FFC951")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 1)) +
  papaja::theme_apa(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 15)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Object overlap", "No overlap", "Location ovelap")) +
  labs(x = "Overlap Type", y = "Difference Score")

5 Results: Mnemonic Similarity Task performance

5.1 descriptive

Age group: 0 YA 1 OA, mr: mean REC, sr: sd REC, ml: mean LDI, sl: sd LDI

mst.tg.a <- mst.tg %>% mutate(age = case_when(SID > 300 ~ 0,
                                              SID < 300 ~ 1))
mst.tg.a$age <- as.factor(mst.tg.a$age)
mst.tg.a$SID <- as.factor(mst.tg.a$SID)

mst.tg.a %>% group_by(age) %>% summarise(mr = mean(REC), sr = sd(REC),
                                           ml = mean(LDI), sl = sd(LDI))
## # A tibble: 2 × 5
##   age      mr     sr    ml    sl
##   <fct> <dbl>  <dbl> <dbl> <dbl>
## 1 0     0.871 0.0674 0.403 0.181
## 2 1     0.801 0.0925 0.230 0.155

The normality assumption was met.

#normality 
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))

for (v in c("REC", "LDI")) {
  for (grp in c(0, 1)) {
    vals <- glt.mst.tg[[v]][glt.mst.tg$age == grp]
    qqnorm(vals, main = paste(v, "| age =", grp))
    qqline(vals)
  }
}

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

The homogeneity of variance assumption was violated for REC ~ age. Thus, to test the age difference in REC, we ran Welch’s t-test.

# homoscedascity
levene_test(REC ~ age, data = mst.tg.a)
## # A tibble: 1 × 4
##     df1   df2 statistic      p
##   <int> <int>     <dbl>  <dbl>
## 1     1    82      6.59 0.0120
levene_test(LDI ~ age, data = mst.tg.a)
## # A tibble: 1 × 4
##     df1   df2 statistic     p
##   <int> <int>     <dbl> <dbl>
## 1     1    82     0.139 0.710

5.2 stats

There were significant age differences both in REC and LDI.

t.test(REC ~ age, data = mst.tg.a)
## 
##  Welch Two Sample t-test
## 
## data:  REC by age
## t = 3.9338, df = 74.96, p-value = 0.0001852
## alternative hypothesis: true difference in means between group 0 and group 1 is not equal to 0
## 95 percent confidence interval:
##  0.034304 0.104696
## sample estimates:
## mean in group 0 mean in group 1 
##       0.8709286       0.8014286
cohens_d(REC ~ age, data = mst.tg.a)
## Cohen's d |       95% CI
## ------------------------
## 0.86      | [0.41, 1.30]
## 
## - Estimated using pooled SD.
t.test(LDI ~ age,data = mst.tg.a, var.equal = TRUE)
## 
##  Two Sample t-test
## 
## data:  LDI by age
## t = 4.6998, df = 82, p-value = 0.00001037
## alternative hypothesis: true difference in means between group 0 and group 1 is not equal to 0
## 95 percent confidence interval:
##  0.0997733 0.2462267
## sample estimates:
## mean in group 0 mean in group 1 
##       0.4026429       0.2296429
cohens_d(LDI ~ age,data = mst.tg.a, var.equal = TRUE)
## Cohen's d |       95% CI
## ------------------------
## 1.03      | [0.57, 1.48]
## 
## - Estimated using pooled SD.

tg.long <- mst.tg.a %>% pivot_longer(cols = c(REC, LDI),

               values_to = "mst_Score")

tg.long %>% mutate(age = factor(age)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Measure, y = mst_Score, color = Measure,

               position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), color = "black") +

               aes(shape = age), color = "black") +
